facts.fact: 暗室里塔萍丝夫人劝杰西卡放圆罗宾进门，许诺他能给她同样的一切
facts.anchor: “Round Robin gives us everything that we could possibly need, everything that we could possibly want,” said the Lady Tuppence. “And he could do the same for you, my dear. All you need to do is let him in.”

facts.fact: 杰西卡恐慌发作，认出这感觉，并溯源到童年母亲恳求她接受耶稣进入内心的旧事
facts.anchor: She was having a panic attack; she knew it. She recognized this feeling. She remembered, when she was a child, when her mother had implored her to accept Jesus into her heart.

facts.fact: 回忆里父母得知真相后给她最后的通牒：做基督的信徒，或者被烧死
facts.anchor: After they learned the truth, her parents had made Jessica a simple offer: You can be a follower of Christ or you can burn.

facts.fact: 塔萍丝夫人把杰西卡比作斯潘基，并说斯潘基当年同样抗拒
facts.anchor: “You remind me of Spunkie,” said the Lady Tuppence. “She was resistant too.

facts.fact: 塔萍丝夫人摊牌二选一：空手回美国收拾残局，或让圆罗宾修复一切
facts.anchor: “But the time has come to make a choice. You can go back to America, with nothing, and try to pick up the pieces of a failed and misspent life. Or you can let Round Robin fix everything for you.”

facts.fact: 杰西卡轻声应下，声音轻得连自己都不确定是否说了出口
facts.anchor: “I want Round Robin to fix things.” She said it so softly she couldn’t be sure she said it at all.

facts.fact: 圆罗宾显出真形：白兔身形、扁口鼻、黄色直眼、耳朵抵到天花板、脸太像人
facts.anchor: It was like in the painting, a sleek white hare with long, slipper-like ears. Its muzzle was flattened like a Persian cat’s, and its insane staring yellow eyes faced front above a pointed nose. Its face was too human for a dumb animal. Its ears brushed the ceiling.

facts.fact: 死亡收束：事情办成，杰西卡从此归属圆罗宾
facts.anchor: But the deed was done and she now belonged to Round Robin.
